name: galpi
description: Apple Silicon and Windows x64 Korean meeting recording and local transcription app
author: m16khb <m16khb@gmail.com>

scripts.check: bun run architecture:check && biome lint . && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.check:worker: uvx ruff check worker && uvx ruff format --check worker && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s worker/tests -t .
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun test && bun run check:rust && bun run check:worker
